loginTagline.en: Paws on the keys — everything lands.

zh.morning: 早安喵，伸个懒腰开工啦
zh.noon: 午间小憩，猫式打盹最养神
zh.afternoon: 午后阳光正好，喵力全开
zh.evening: 暮色渐浓，收工前再扑最后一次
zh.night: 夜深了，剩下的交给梦，喵

en.morning: Morning stretch, paws on the keys.
en.noon: A midday catnap recharges the claws.
en.evening: Dusk settles in — one last pounce.
en.night: The night is quiet. Curl up and rest, meow.
